specs.Item Highlight: Folding Stand and Hand Strap, Scratch Protection for Reading Comfort, Textured Leather Finish, Responsive Support

features: PERFECT FIT FOR KINDLE PAPERWHITE 2024: Specifically tailored for the Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation 2024 (7"), this case ensures a precise fit with accurate cutouts for easy access to all buttons and features. Its thoughtful design combines style, protection, and convenience, tailored specifically for your devices size and functionality.

VINTAGE EMBOSSED LEATHER CASE: Experience the charm of classic literature with this faux leather case featuring elegant embossed corner details. Its vintage-inspired design adds a timeless, book-like appeal to your Kindle Paperwhite, making your e-reader feel like a treasured volume while keeping modern style and durability in perfect balance.

FULL PROTECTION & DURABILITY: Crafted from high-quality faux leather, this case shields your Kindle from everyday scratches, dust, and minor bumps. The snug inner holder secures your device in place, giving you peace of mind whether at home, commuting, or traveling, while maintaining a sleek and professional look.

COMFORTABLE HAND STRAP: Designed for one-handed reading, the built-in hand strap provides comfort and stability when holding your Kindle Paperwhite. This feature keeps your device securely in your grasp during long reading sessions, making it easy to enjoy your favorite books on the couch, in bed, or on the go.

CONVENIENT FOLDING STAND: Enjoy hands-free reading or viewing with the integrated folding stand. The stand function allows you to adjust the case for a comfortable angle, making it ideal for relaxed reading, online studying, or streaming content while keeping your hands free for note-taking or multitasking.

KINDLE PAPERWHITE TPU EREADER COVER: This protective cover is designed specifically for 7'' Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen 2024 and offers reliable daily protection in a slim and lightweight form. With a flexible TPU back and smooth leather style front, it shields your device from drops and scratches while maintaining a sleek and professional look.

FULL COVERAGE WITH 2 PIECE DESIGN: The combination of a flexible TPU back cover and a refined leather style front provides strong protection without adding bulk. The TPU absorbs impact from accidental drops while the smooth exterior creates a premium feel that enhances both durability and visual appeal for everyday use.

AUTO WAKE AND SLEEP FUNCTION: The built in magnetic closure activates the automatic wake and sleep feature of the Kindle Paperwhite twelfth generation. Opening the cover instantly wakes your device for reading and closing it puts the screen to sleep to conserve battery life .

REMOVABLE FRONT INSERT: The front cover is a detachable panel that allows you to personalize the look or adjust the functionality of the case. This flexible design makes it easy to remove or replace the insert, offering added convenience and customization based on your preferences.

MAGNETIC CLOSURE AND SCREEN PROTECTION: Strong integrated magnets keep the cover securely closed to prevent accidental openings during travel or daily use. Inside the front cover, a soft anti scratch lining protects the screen from dust fingerprints and scuffs ensuring your reader stays clean and safe at all times.
description: For readers using the 7-inch Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen 2024 or Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition, this case keeps the e-reader covered during daily reading, commuting, study, and travel. It suits users who want a slim cover with a leather-style finish and easy device access.The detachable design makes it convenient to remove the reader when needed, while the cover supports automatic wake and sleep for compatible devices. Its PU shell helps shield the reader from everyday scuffs during handling and storage.Compared with carrying an uncovered Kindle e-reader, the case adds a defined grip and a protective outer layer without a bulky profile. The cover is designed specifically for the listed Kindle models rather than a universal tablet fit.Wipe the surface with a soft, dry cloth and keep the case away from excess moisture and direct heat. Detach the reader gently from the corners and confirm that the cover is aligned before closing.
